page_title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi | Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare | MoA&FW
headings: Exclusion Categories for Higher Economic Status
key_paragraphs: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from Government of India.
Under the scheme, income support of Rs. 6000/- per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2000/- each will be provided to all landholding farmer families.
The fund will be directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.
bullet_points: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable landholding in their names are eligible.
Bank accounts must be seeded with Aadhaar and mapped with NPCI.
Institutional landholders and income tax payees are strictly excluded.

page_title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) | Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
headings: Coverage of Crops and Stages of Risk
key_paragraphs: PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses against non-preventable natural risks.
Farmer premium share is capped at 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
bullet_points: Available for all farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
Post-harvest losses covered up to 14 days for crops in cut-and-spread condition.
Claims processed directly into Aadhaar-linked accounts.

page_title: Soil Health Card Portal | Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
key_paragraphs: The scheme promotes soil testing to issue Soil Health Cards to all farmers at a 2-year interval.
Evaluates 12 parameters: N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, and Organic Carbon.
bullet_points: 100% free of cost to all farmers across India.
Customized fertilizer dosage recommendations based on soil test results.
Promotes balanced use of fertilizers and reduces unnecessary expenditure.

ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka
page_title: Raita Mitra Portal | Agriculture Department | Government of Karnataka
headings: Krishi Bhagya Scheme - Rainfed Farming Modernization
Raitha Shakti Scheme - Farm Mechanization Diesel Subsidy
Karnataka Raitha Siri - Minor Millet Incentive
key_paragraphs: Krishi Bhagya provides up to 80% capital subsidy for farm pond construction and polythene lining in dry-zone taluks.
Raitha Shakti provides diesel subsidy of Rs. 250 per acre up to 5 acres directly into farmer bank accounts via DBT.
bullet_points: Beneficiaries must possess registered land records in Karnataka FRUITS portal.
Priority funding for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) smallholders.
Millets promotion incentive of Rs. 10,000 per hectare for registered growers.
